workload_type: chat (low-latency), reranking for search re-rank during user sessions
latency_targets: P95 < 80ms for short chat responses (<= 256 tokens); P99 < 250ms during normal traffic; degrade to P99 < 600ms during controlled bursts
throughput_targets: Baseline target: 60k tokens/sec sustained across cluster during market hours; min guaranteed: 45k tokens/sec sustained (contracted); spike target: 120k tokens/sec for up to 5 minutes with burst policy
concurrency_caps: Per-model concurrent request cap requested: 120 concurrent seqs for large chat model family, 400 for small rerank models. Want a hard cap guarantee and a predictable soft-cap fallback with reduced model variant routing.
burst_policy: Customer requires defined burst buckets: 2x sustained for up to 5 minutes (no SLA credit), 4x sustained for up to 30s with partial credits if requests dropped. Wants explicit cold-start protection: pre-warmed cache within 60s for scheduled market events.
reserved_gpu_plan: Proposal A: 8x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs + 40% burst buffer via autoscaling credits; Proposal B (cheaper): 6x reserved + dedicated warm-standby pool billed on-minute for peak events. Customer prefers predictable reserved baseline with capped burst credits.
